metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An epic adventure about a young Viking and his loyal dragon friend, perfect for fans of action and heartwarming fantasy.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A hilarious twist on the superhero genre with lots of laugh-out-loud comedy, similar to Shrek and Despicable Me.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: A highly creative and colorful comedy about a machine that makes food fall from the sky, matching the humor of Migration.

metas.name: WALL-E
metas.description: A heartwarming Pixar sci-fi adventure featuring a lovable robot that will capture the imagination of the whole family.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A beautiful adventure about an elderly man, a young Wilderness Explorer, and a talking dog flying in a balloon house.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A thrilling and fun family-superhero adventure that blends incredible action with relatable family dynamics.

metas.name: Mulan
metas.description: An inspiring Disney classic packed with action, courage, and comedy from the lovable dragon Mushu.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A delightful adventure through different video game worlds, perfect for fans of Sonic the Hedgehog and Mario.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: An action-packed sci-fi comedy focusing on the heartwarming bond between a young inventor and a gentle, inflatable robot.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A magical, modern-day fantasy adventure about two elf brothers trying to spend one more day with their dad.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A beautiful, warm story of friendship, summer fun, and sea monsters exploring a coastal Italian town.

metas.name: Soul
metas.description: A beautifully animated story about finding passion and joy in everyday life, from the creators of Inside Out.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A wild and wacky comedy about zoo animals shipwrecked on an island, sharing the upbeat energy of Ice Age.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: An early Pixar favorite full of miniature heroism, fun characters, and exciting bug adventures.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A sweet and funny look at what pets do when their owners leave for work, made by the studio behind Despicable Me.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A magical journey across China to return a lost yeti to his home, filled with warmth and beautiful music.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A prehistoric road trip adventure about a family learning to embrace the unknown, filled with colorful creatures.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A delightfully spooky but entirely kid-friendly comedy about monsters having a peaceful vacation.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A heartwarming live-action/animated hybrid about a polite bear from Peru who finds a family in London.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: A universally beloved sequel packed with joyful charm, clever comedy, and beautiful family values.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A high-octane Pixar story about a race car learning the true value of friendship and community in a small town.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: An incredibly fast-paced, funny, and imaginative adventure about an ordinary Lego minifigure saving the world.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: An action-adventure story about a celebrity dog who thinks he has real superpowers embarking on a cross-country trip.

metas.name: Meet the Robinsons
metas.description: An optimistic and creative time-travel adventure about finding your family and always moving forward.

metas.name: Tarzan
metas.description: A high-flying Disney adventure with an incredible soundtrack by Phil Collins and a story about belonging.

metas.name: Hercules
metas.description: A lively and comedic Disney spin on Greek mythology with gospel music, heroic tasks, and funny sidekicks.

metas.name: Aladdin
metas.description: A legendary Disney musical fantasy featuring magical genie antics, beautiful songs, and a flying carpet ride.

metas.name: Beauty and the Beast
metas.description: A classic fairy tale featuring talking household items, beautiful animation, and a magical castle setting.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: An incredibly funny, fast-paced buddy comedy about an arrogant emperor turned into a llama.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A charming and gentle 3D adaptation of Charlie Brown and Snoopy's classic adventures, perfect for all ages.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A beautiful Ghibli fantasy about tiny people living under the floorboards, matching the magic of Totoro.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A whimsical Studio Ghibli fantasy about a girl who can talk to cats and is brought to a magical cat kingdom.

metas.name: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
metas.description: A hilarious claymation mystery with the same charming stop-motion style and humor as Chicken Run.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: A brilliant, dialogue-free slapstick comedy that is incredibly fun and easy to enjoy for kids of all ages.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A hilarious and visually stunning adventure about a quirky family who accidentally must save the world from robots.

metas.name: Ron's Gone Wrong
metas.description: A lovely and funny story about a boy and his malfunctioning digital companion learning about true friendship.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A musical fantasy adventure about a young girl who builds a rocket to the moon to find a legendary moon goddess.

metas.name: Arthur Christmas
metas.description: A highly inventive, funny, and heartwarming Christmas-themed adventure about Santa's high-tech operation.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A modern musical fairy tale celebrating Disney's classic animation legacy with lots of magic and hope.

metas.name: Ferdinand
metas.description: A heartwarming and funny story about a giant, gentle bull who prefers smelling flowers to fighting.
